content.short: Galxe provides credential infrastructure that all Web3 developers can access.
content.description: Galxe is building a credential data network accessible to all Web3 developers. The platform serves both on-chain and off-chain communities, enabling them to curate, verify, and contribute digital credentials to a shared network that can be leveraged across projects. For off-chain credentials, it connects data sources from multiple orgs, such as Snapshot, Twitter, and GitHub. For on-chain credentials, it relies on subgraph queries or static snapshots to capture on-chain activity and attestations.
content.meta: Galxe builds a credential data network open to all developers in Web3. Discover Galxe and other Identity Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
